frame: system frame: x,y in the reference orbital plane, z toward orbital north; unit direction vectors
note: One celestial sphere serves every viewpoint in the system; in-system parallax is invisible. Stars are sorted brightest first, so index-based ids (star-0001 is the brightest) stay stable for naming. A few spare stars were nudged (median 2.5°) to form the sculpted constellations; see "sculpted".
